items.source:
Technologies to check the exposure of the endpoint on while considering it to be
available.
items.translation: 用于在将端点视为可用时检查其暴露情况的技术。

items.source: Matches access according to the endpoint's specific Environment property, falling back to management.endpoints.default-access or failing that Endpoint.defaultAccess().
items.translation: 根据端点特定的 Environment 属性匹配访问权限， 否则回退到 management.endpoints.default-access， 若仍失败则使用 Endpoint.defaultAccess()。

items.source: Matches exposure according to any of the management.endpoints.web.exposure.<id> or management.endpoints.jmx.exposure.<id> specific properties or failing that to whether any EndpointExposureOutcomeContributor exposes the endpoint.
items.translation: 根据 `management.endpoints.web.exposure.<id>` 或 `management.endpoints.jmx.exposure.<id>` 的特定属性匹配端点暴露情况，若未找到则取决于是否有任何 EndpointExposureOutcomeContributor 暴露该端点。

items.source:
Both enablement and exposure conditions should match for the endpoint to be considered
available.
items.translation: 启用条件和暴露条件均应匹配，端点才被视为可用。
